verdict.rationale: Agora documents a first-party quality monitoring and analytics offering covering real-time monitoring, measurement, alerts, diagnostics, and quality and performance analytics for voice and video. These are high-level marketing claims only, so it is unclear whether per-session metrics are exposed through a dashboard or API. missing for 10: explicit per-session/per-call drill-down, named metrics (packet loss, jitter, bitrate), documented API access to quality data, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, and bitrate are available through a dashboard or API for debugging calls

citations.quote: Improve quality of experience with real-time monitoring, measurement, alerts, and diagnostics.
Usage, quality, and performance analytics for real-time voice & video
